title: Room Spray Rituals: 5 Ways to Refresh Your Space
excerpt: A simple guide to using room spray with intention across entryways, bedrooms, living spaces and everyday reset moments.
content: Room spray can become a small ritual rather than a last-minute refresh. Start with a clean space, choose one scent mood and use a light amount where air can circulate. Entryways can create a welcoming first impression, bedrooms can support a softer evening atmosphere, and living spaces can be refreshed before guests arrive.

title: How to Choose a Fragrance That Feels Like You
excerpt: A practical framework for choosing between bold, bright, warm and soft fragrance profiles.
content: Start with the mood you want to create. Bold profiles can feel more commanding, bright profiles can feel clean and open, warm profiles can feel rich, and soft profiles can feel intimate. A discovery set can help you compare before choosing a signature.

title: Why a Discovery Box Makes Fragrance Shopping Easier
excerpt: How sampling several scent directions can reduce guesswork when choosing a signature fragrance.
content: A discovery box gives you a practical way to experience multiple scent directions before choosing a full-size fragrance. Test each on separate occasions and note which one fits your preferred mood and setting.

title: Private Label Fragrance: What Brands Should Prepare First
excerpt: The key information to include when you contact a fragrance manufacturing partner.
content: Brands should prepare their product category, expected quantity, packaging direction, target market and desired timeline. A clear initial brief helps a manufacturing discussion move faster and makes the first conversation more useful.

title: Agarbatti for a Sacred Home: Aahuti, Pushpanjali, Samidha & Somdhara
excerpt: Meet the Scentvent Co. masala agarbatti range and learn how to create a sacred space at home.
content:
Every Scentvent Co. agarbatti is a premium masala agarbatti crafted using the 500-year-old traditional method, with natural wood powder, pure essential oils and sacred herbs — no charcoal and no harmful chemicals.

Aahuti (Dhoopam Samarpayami) is a sacred dhoop offering for daily puja. Pushpanjali (Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam) is a floral offering made with love. Samidha (Shanti Samarpayami) is an offering of peace and calm, and Somdhara (Pushpam Samarpayami) brings a serene, flowing mood to your prayer space. Each box holds 100 g.

How to create a sacred space: light the tip of the incense stick, gently blow out the flame, then place it on an incense holder and let the luxury spread. Never leave burning incense unattended, and keep it away from children, pets and fabrics.
